initial_assumptions: Novel missense variant with conflicting in-silico scores (REVEL 0.52)
Initially classified as VUS in clinical laboratory

evidence_schedule.content: Cardiomyopathy VCEP rule: LoF is not a mechanism for HCM (dominant negative / missense gain); PVS1 is strictly disallowed.
Residue Arg719 is part of the actin-binding loop (PM1 hotspot) alongside established pathogenic variants p.Arg719Gln and p.Arg719Pro (PM5).
CONTRADICTION: Initial mild in-silico prediction invalidated by large international HCM registry showing rigorous co-segregation across 5 families (LOD = 4.2). Strong segregation PP1_Strong applies.
Purified human myosin actin-gliding motility assay confirms severe ATPase kinetic defect (PS3).

ground_truth.provenance: Reclassified from VUS to Pathogenic following clinical registry segregation.
